WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS cc_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS cc_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 10
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH wl AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.dispatch_ts_utc,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
)
SELECT 'lines' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl FROM wl
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_not_900', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM wl WHERE store_id <> 900
UNION ALL SELECT 'status_'||status, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM wl GROUP BY status
UNION ALL SELECT 'ful_'||fulfilment_type, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM wl GROUP BY fulfilment_type
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_fulfil', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM wl WHERE fulfilment_type IS NULL
